Digital health partnerships don't happen on autopilot - you actually have to show up. So we did. Last week, the #MSDIdeaStudioEurope team went to Paris, to exchange with our MSD France colleagues and show why and how we partner and collaborate with #digitalhealth startups across Europe. ✨Day 1 was focused on collaboration and execution: - A full day with colleagues from MSD France, meeting with Clinical Trial, business unit teams and startups. - Having strategic conversations with the MSD France Leadership Team. Thank you so much Clarisse Lhoste for the best of welcomes and the extremely valuable exchange with you and your team. Aurélie ANDRIEUX-BONNEAU Olivier Fouret Clémentine DURANTET Julien Aguiar Lamia Boudiaf, MD, MSc and many more. These discussions reinforced a core belief of ours: meaningful innovation happens when business, technology, and startups come together early - and stay connected. ✨Day 2 opened the lens to the wider digital health and startup ecosystem. Together with MSD France colleagues, we joined the Future4care #DemoDay , exploring emerging digital health solutions from the F4C Accelerator. A very big thank you to Katherine Ossenkopp for the invitation and the organization, especially for the curated VIP Tours. With over 100 startups and 750+ visitors we would not have seen such a great selection that fits our use-cases. 💥 My Takeaway "Turning Innovation into Reality - The power of Industry-Startup-Provider Collaboration" - was not only the title of the panel with Joel Krikston representing our MSD GHI Fund but also the outcome of those two days: Innovation doesn’t scale in silos and execution happens when ecosystems (and colleagues!) meet. 🥐Thank you Astrid de Hauteclocque for the whole organization for our team Kirsten Hoyer Cyril Schiever Azèle Mathieu Alba Zurriaga Carda Marcus Höglund

moveUP - digital therapies and Cascador Health are merging to create a leading data-driven digital health provider 👨‍⚕📱 Cascador Health and moveUP today announce the completion of their merger, creating critical mass by combining two digital health specialists. The combined company already works with 8 of the top 10 global pharmaceutical companies, operates internationally, and supports more than 100,000 patients globally across its solutions. Customers include Astra Zeneca, Sanofi, UCB and ArgenX. The joint company will go by the name of Cascador/moveUP and can rely on a multidisciplinary staff of 35 specialists based in Brussels and Ghent 💊🌎 Investors from both companies have invested €6 million in fresh capital alongside the merger — a signal of confidence in the strategy and a recognition for the market position the companies have established in therapeutic areas such as epilepsy, orthopedics, respiratory immunology and rare diseases. The shared mission: to unlock the value of health data to help deliver the right treatment to the right patient at the right time 🧪✨ Read full article here in L'Echo - Arnaud Martin : https://lnkd.in/en5q4ffq cc. Carole Absil nommée administratrice générale adjointe de la Banque-Carrefour de la sécurité sociale ➡️ Carole Absil succède à Thibaut Duvillier , qui a occupé la fonction d'administrateur général adjoint de la BCSS durant douze ans. Figure reconnue de l'e-gouvernement et de l'e-santé en Belgique, celui-ci a notamment contribué au développement des services numériques de la sécurité sociale et de la Plate-forme eHealth avant de rejoindre le Collège intermutualiste national. A lire dans Le Spécialiste https://lnkd.in/e_KD44BS ➡️ Elle rejoindra au sein du comité de direction Frank Robben , administrateur général de la BCSS depuis de nombreuses années et considéré comme l'un des architectes de l'e-gouvernement belge. Sous son impulsion, la Banque-Carrefour de la Sécurite Sociale et la Plate-forme eHealth sont devenues des acteurs centraux de la gestion et de l'échange sécurisé des données publiques et de santé.
linkedin_activity.text_en: Carole Absil appointed Deputy Managing Director of the Banque-Carrefour de la sécurité sociale ➡️ Carole Absil succeeds Thibaut Duvillier , who served as Deputy Managing Director of the BCSS for twelve years. To read in The Specialist ➡️ https://lnkd.in/e_KD44BS She will join the management committee Frank Robben , general director of the BCSS for many years and considered one of the architects of the Belgian e-government. Under his leadership, the Crossroads Bank for Social Security and the eHealth Platform have become central players in the management and secure exchange of public and health data.

linkedin_activity.text: 🧐 How will AI reshape healthcare over the next decade? This was one of the key questions I explored at #BioCap26 , Life Science and AI Investival, happening for the first time. 🎤 "From Treatment to Prevention: How Data and AI Are Rebuilding the Healthcare Business Model" 🏥 Ayelet Akselrod-Ballin, PhD , Head & CTO of the AI Center at Sheba Medical Center, Tel Hashomer , shared fascinating insights from the hospital perspective, especially into the pioneering work of Sheba's dedicated AI unit and how AI is already transforming clinical decision-making and healthcare delivery. 🚀 Dr. Mridul Agrawal , Co-Founder & Managing Director of iuvando Health , shed light on the startup world and highlighted how patients, trial centers, and sponsors can benefit from AI-driven solutions that improve clinical trial access and cancer care pathways. 💊 From the #pharma perspective, I presented how we see AI creating impact across the value chain, from drug discovery and clinical development to commercial excellence and patient engagement. Including our AI-powered selection processes within the #MSDIdeaStudioEurope to identify and collaborate with promising startup partners. 🤝 My personal #highlight was sharing the stage with Mridul. While our participation on the same panel was pure coincidence, MSD Deutschland and Iuvando have been working together for several years. I'm incredibly proud of this partnership and the impact it creates for cancer patients. Through awareness, education, AI-based matching technology, and hands-on support for both patients and trial sites, iuvando helps patients find suitable clinical trials closer to home, helping to close an important care gap. ❓ One question resonated throughout the discussion: Which healthcare player will be most effected by #AI in healthcare? Everyone thinks it's their own field, but maybe (hopefully) it's patients. Too often, discussions around AI focus on technology rather than people. Yet AI has the potential to empower patients, for better access to information, more personalized support, improved navigation of the healthcare system, and ultimately better health outcomes. A big thank you to Helena Smolak ( Handelsblatt ) for moderating such an fresh and engaging way. 🌱 Beyond the panel itself, BioCap brought together an inspiring mix of founders, investors, and industry leaders. Every time I passed by the startup stage, it was packed - a great sign for the lively, evolving innovation ecosystem in Europe. Great opportunities to reconnect with familiar faces and meet new ones. A special thank you to Planet A Ventures for the invitation to a great networking event during a week when Berlin truly felt like the center of the life sciences and #VentureCapital world! 👏 Looking forward to seeing BioCap grow in the years ahead! #BioCapEurope #ArtificialIntelligence #DigitalHealth #ClinicalTrials #LifeSciences #Biotech
